trigger.plain: An hourly candle closes above yesterday's high, after H1 gets back above EMA9.

decisions.wrong_if: A daily close below bar_low: the failed contraction breakout flips (C23) and I am out.
decisions.reason: Breakout family (C2/C12): D 0.1% above last swing high, W 0.1% under 20-wk high, both HH/HL, sma_distance_pct 0.46 so entry and invalidation sit close (C20). H1 is below EMA9 (LH but EL, 46% of range), so the entry waits for the H1 close above bar_high.

declarations: bar_range_history NOT_SERVED (R5): atr_14d is not a trustworthy contraction read, so the call rests on structure_shift and sma_distance_pct. No bracket field is a reason (R1).
